component.name: Nearby Cast
component.summary: Cast your Linux desktop to nearby displays

description.p: NearbyCast discovers nearby displays and casts your Linux desktop using the best available sender path. Google Cast uses a low-latency fragmented MP4 stream verified to reach PLAYING on Android TV Cast receivers. Miracast, AirPlay lab, and authenticated NearbyCast-to-NearbyCast paths are also supported where hardware and protocol limits allow.
The application uses Wayland capture through wf-recorder / portals when available, probes real encoders before selection, and only reports Connected after the receiver accepts media.
Production hardening: fMP4 Cast transport, protocol router, virtual lab, Flatpak on GNOME 49.
